You see a crowbar (Atk:5, Def:6).
Classification: 1 Tier: 0.
It weighs 21.00 oz.
It may come in handy sometime.

Notes

Crowbars can be used to fix or destroy certain objects. Also it is the lowest attack club and is good for Training. Needed in one of The Postman Missions, in the The Ape City Quest, and for the In Service of Yalahar Quest. Unlocks a door in the Desert Dungeon.

You can use the Whacking Driller of Fate as a substitution for this tool.
